notes: For cementitious grout, prefer alkaline or grout-specific cleaners and thorough rinsing. Do not recommend straight vinegar or other acids as a routine method because acids can attack cement-based grout. Avoid oil/wax cleaners that can leave residue. For mold-related grout issues, distinguish ordinary surface cleaning from larger moisture/mold problems and never recommend mixing bleach with other cleaners.
